quote.text: Imagine for yourself a character, a model personality, whose example you determine to follow, in private as well as in public.
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Emulate a character of virtue at home, knowing that each action, whether seen or unseen, shapes your children’s understanding of integrity and compassion.
    • Be the exemplar in everyday life—nurturing a consistent inner life that naturally flows into your interactions, guiding your children towards wisdom and resilience.
  • Leadership
    • Adopt an ideal character whose virtues, from fairness to humility, become the standard you set for those you lead, ensuring your private conduct mirrors your public decisions.
    • Leaders who follow such a model inspire trust and loyalty, transforming challenges into opportunities for collective growth and ethical achievement.
  • Product Management
    • Create and nurture a product vision that reflects the highest standards of clarity, kindness, and purpose—just as a model personality would embody the best of your ideals.
    • Let your decisions, whether in development or strategy, be guided by profound consistency and an unyielding commitment to quality, ensuring every iteration speaks to your core values.
